name: TIGRESS
method_summary: TIGRESS formulates GRN inference as a sparse regression problem and combines LARS-based feature selection with stability selection over repeated sample splits. It produces directed unsigned regulator-target scores from gene expression data.

optional.usage: Wrapper passes tf_list.txt as TIGRESS tflist, restricting candidate regulators; if absent, the wrapper uses all expression genes as candidate regulators.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_emulated because ANDREA partitions the dataset by group before running the tool.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv to create one TIGRESS child run per group; each child calls tigress::tigress on that group's expression matrix.

progress.note: TIGRESS package API does not expose fine-grained callbacks for per-target execution progress; wrapper reports only coarse lifecycle states in progress.json.

alpha.description: Randomization parameter for stability selection weighting in [0,1].

nstepsLARS.description: Maximum number of LARS steps used by TIGRESS.

nsplit.description: Number of sample splits used in stability selection.

normalizeexp.description: Whether to mean-center and scale expression values per gene.

allsteps.description: Whether TIGRESS returns scores for all LARS steps up to nstepsLARS.

usemulticore.description: Whether TIGRESS uses its internal multicore path.

limit.description: Optional number of top regulatory links to return. If null, all links are returned.

oneOf.description: Use null to return all links.

seed.description: Optional random seed used by wrapper before calling TIGRESS.
